metadata.description: clawd-buddy-mod: an unofficial Claude Code mod that puts an animated Clawd above your prompt.

plugins.name: clawd-buddy
plugins.description: Clawd strolls while Claude works, skates for shell commands, drives off with subagents, flies a kite for web fetches and hops when you talk to him. Under him: a context forecast and your 5-hour and weekly limits. In the terminal and the desktop app.
